# Chapter I - General {#c1}

## A. Applicability {#a}

1. These Directions apply to all commercial banks and non-banking financial companies that extend credit through digital lending apps, whether their own or those of a lending service provider.

# Chapter II - Disclosures to Borrowers {#c2}

## B. Key Fact Statement {#b}

2. A regulated entity shall provide a Key Fact Statement to the borrower before the execution of the loan contract, in a standardised format, stating the annual percentage rate, the recovery mechanism, the details of the grievance redressal officer and the cooling-off period.

3. The annual percentage rate shall include all fees and charges payable by the borrower, other than contingent charges such as penal charges and late payment charges.

## C. Cooling-off Period {#c}

4. The borrower shall be given a cooling-off period of not less than three days for loans with a tenor of seven days or more, and not less than one day for loans with a tenor of less than seven days, during which the borrower may exit the loan by paying the principal and the proportionate annual percentage rate without any penalty.

# Chapter III - Data Protection {#c3}

## D. Collection of Data {#d}

5. Digital lending apps shall not access the file and media, contact list, call logs or telephony functions of the borrower. A one-time access may be taken for camera, microphone and location only for onboarding or KYC requirements, with the explicit consent of the borrower.

6. Regulated entities shall ensure that all data is stored only in servers located in India.
